journey.name: paykit server approval before the node starts
journey.description: Verifies that a Bitcoin watch-only Paykit Server setup approved before the Lightning node has started completes on the first Authorize, and that the node tracks the new account once it starts. Precondition: an isolated wallet with a Pubky identity, on the integration fixture runtime described in this README, and a fresh setup auth URL with x-bitkit-claim=watch-only-account-v1 from the Shop's Connect Bitkit dialog or the Paykit Server setup fixture. iOS keeps the node running in the background, so the window is a cold start.

actions.action: Record the current wallet's watch-only account names and derivation paths
Hold node setup: stall the fixture's VSS backup endpoint (pause its container, or hold reads at a proxy), so the node build cannot finish
Open the fixture's bitkit://pubky-auth/setup URL with `xcrun simctl openurl <simulator-id> "<url>"` so it cold-starts the app, and unlock it
Before the app log shows "Node started", tap Approve on the receiving-details introduction
Tap Authorize and complete PIN or biometrics if asked
Verify the success screen appears and no node or wallet error toast is shown

Verify the app log for this launch has "Paykit Server account N tracking stored without a node" for the new account, written before the success screen. It is logged only when the approval found no node, so it proves the approval did not wait for node setup. If the line is missing, the hold did not take effect: fix it and repeat from the terminate step
Verify the Shop dialog or the fixture reports the setup as complete, and the app log still has no "LDK node setup" line for this launch
Wait for the wallet to finish syncing, then open the watch-only accounts list in Settings
Verify exactly one new account was added, named after the requesting service, with tracking on

Verify the app log shows the node loaded that account index ("Registered derived on-chain wallet account" or "Loaded configured wallet for OnchainWalletAccount" with its account_index) and no "Provided xpub does not match the node's master seed" error
